newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber steady this week despite tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber steady this week despite tight supply.

text.p: Thai rubber prices were barely changed this week despite tighter supply as demand remained sluggish, traders said on Friday.

"There are some Chinese and Japanese buyers in the market this week, But they only purchased small amounts," one trader said. "I think demand in China remains good. However, some are cautious about their (Chinese buyers) credit and reluctant to sell much," he said.
Rains in the southern Thai region hampered rubber tapping, resulting in lower supplies. Only 330,877 kgs of rubber was traded in the local market this week, compared with 626,437 kgs last week.
Latex prices were quoted at 93-95 cents a kg in the rubber auction market.
Despite tighter supply, traders were not too optimistic that prices would pick up much as high rubber stocks in Japan remained bad news.
"Smaller supply could support the price, but I don't expect to see any rally if the demand continues to be sluggish," said another trader.
